description.value: A Bite of Shunde is a Chinese restaurant in Richmond, BC, specializing in cuisine from Shunde — a district in Guangdong province renowned as a cradle of Cantonese cooking. Richmond's dense concentration of authentic regional Chinese restaurants makes this part of a notable food destination for cyclists exploring the area. Touring cyclists passing through on the River Road or Garden City corridors have a range of nearby dining options, with this spot representing a more specialized regional offering.
